parcalar.metin: Egg Man went right. His shadow bolted left.
Look, he even waved. His shadow ignored him.
The cat meowed as if to say, go after it!
The shadow slipped under a bench. His scarf got caught.
Then he noticed. The shadow stayed on the lit sidewalk.
It wasn’t running away. It had turned the streetlight into a stage.
Egg Man flipped the switch. He thought the show was over.
Then the cat switched on a flashlight. The shadow had its first fan.
